translations.web: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
